verdicts.explanation: The paper computes 19.7 × 10−3 S cm−1 in this work via Nernst-Einstein from its own AIMD diffusion data extrapolated to 300 K, so computational origin, Li3PS4 glass, and the 300 K temperature (26.85 °C) are right. Secondary fields are null, which is correct because the paper gives no sintering, density, or activation-energy value in eV.
The 19.0 × 10−3 S cm−1 value is explicitly described as 'reported in prior simulations. 14', so literature_cited is correct. No temperature is stated for this value, so null is correct.

The ~2.8–3.0 × 10−4 S cm−1 experimental range is attributed to refs 11 and 15 and is not measured in this paper, so literature_cited is correct. The paper gives no measurement temperature for it, so null is correct; the material is the Li3PS4 glass the paper compares against.
